messages:
Noelle (AE): Velox AI just escalated to their CTO; POC is blocked. Their list: SSO failing with audience mismatch, spikes in p95 when clients use our quantized model under mixed short/long sessions, and procurement wants a 30-day pilot price with option to switch to reserved capacity. They want an exec bridge today.

Samir (Presales): I'll own pricing. Quick ask: do we model a month-to-month pilot on Hosted or Dedicated? Procurement prefers hosted but asks about a reserved discount if they convert. I can draft both.

Ivy (SRE): I dug into the logs: when sequences mix (short <=64 + long >=1500) the KV eviction rate spikes and p95 goes up. Quantized variant shows higher p99s under cold KV misses. I can run a focused canary with kv-prefetch + short-term quant warmup. Need sanitized prompt set from Velox.

Belen (Security): On SSO: audience mismatch implies SP metadata mismatch. Ask them for IdP metadata XML + the raw SAML response (redacted). For BYO-KMS/HSM: we can support wrapped keys, but Legal needs DPA addendum. I'll collate SOC2 link + KMS attestation.

Marco (Legal): We can fast-track a scoped DPA addendum for BYO-KMS pilot. If they require HSM attestation or on-prem key custody, that'll need extra counsel but we can include an HSM clause. Need to know whether keys ever leave their control (wrapped/unwrapped).

BridgeBot: Bridge created: BR-12044. Tentative 15:30 PT. Use /bridge confirm to add agenda items.

Noelle (AE): Owners: Samir=pricing; Ivy=SRE perf + canary; Belen=security artifacts + KMS path; Marco=DPA addendum. Can someone craft a short one-liner for the exec invite?

Samir (Presales): Draft one-liner: "Run a focused canary (kv-prefetch + quant warmup), complete SSO metadata exchange, and present a 30-day pilot with a convertible reserved-capacity pricing option to close the POC."

Ivy (SRE): Canary command (sanitized):
```
./run_canary --target https://poc.velox.redwood/generate --concurrency 80 --seq-mix short:60,long:40 --kv-prefetch --quant-warmup
```
I'll route 5% traffic to canary and post quick metrics in ~20m.

Belen (Security): Links: SOC2: https://vault.redwood/artifacts/soc2-2025.pdf, KMS attestation: https://vault.redwood/artifacts/kms-attest.pdf. Will ask Velox for IdP metadata and SAML response now.

Ivy (SRE): Canary tail: [2026-03-23T18:12Z] run=c120 p95=710ms p99=1.4s kv_miss=23% ; [2026-03-23T18:28Z] run=c121 p95=330ms p99=640ms kv_miss=5.5% (after prefetch + warmup). CSV uploaded: https://perf.redwood/runs/c120.csv

Samir (Presales): Draft pilot pricing posted: https://pricing.redwood/drafts/velox-pilot. Two options: 30-day hosted pilot at pilot rate, or 30-day hosted + conversion credit to Dedicated reserved capacity (3-6mo commit equivalence). I'll refine before bridge.

Marco (Legal): Draft DPA addendum uploaded: https://legal.redwood/drafts/velox-dpa. If Velox wants BYO-HSM, I'll add an HSM clause and loop counsel.

Noelle (AE): Sending bridge invite now with the one-liner and artifacts. Agenda: 1) SRE shows canary results, 2) Security reviews SSO + KMS path, 3) Presales presents 30-day pilot + conversion options, 4) Legal outlines DPA timeline. Thanks team.

BridgeBot: Reminder: BR-12044 in 15 minutes.

Noelle (AE): Post-bridge: CTO accepted the canary numbers and SSO plan. Procurement requested final pilot quote and the DPA; Samir and Marco to deliver tomorrow morning. Closing loop here.
